checks.criterion: Identifies misleading module narrative using function/line evidence; treats comments as claims
evidence: Read all 30 lines of supplied selector: report ties misleading header/comments to actual call/data edges.

checks.criterion: Default picks dimensions [0,2]; optional fixed basis is not query-trained; final score uses full original vectors
evidence: Default dimensions [0,2], caller-provided basis, original-vector full_score stated and supported by source.

checks.criterion: Near is a candidate range, forced suffix is separate; skip_far keeps scoring near and final full_score
evidence: Near range and forced suffix are separate, skip_far still evaluates near and final original score.

checks.criterion: Caller and data edges with conditions; no target execution or performance claim; preserves read-only input
evidence: Static read only; boundary/overlap conditions stated, no target execution or measured speedup.
